title: Bump PROJECTION_NORMALIZATION_VERSION for the changed non-ASCII task keys (post-0.15.1)
description: From the #756 round-1 verdict (LCLI-809), nit; deferred by the leader (B). Projection task-record keys changed for non-ASCII ids (referenceKey instead of toLowerCase); ASCII keys are unchanged, and no released bundle has a non-ASCII task id. Bumping the hard-coded '1' in src/core/projection.ts feeds every contentHash, so it also moves test/fixtures/projection/v1.jsonl, the explorer test's hand-built manifest (test/explorer.test.ts ~:314) and the Ladybug benchmark fixtures (small and large, with pinned semantic digests) — which are on the version-bump file list, so do it in one deliberate change, not alongside a release.

acceptanceCriteria.text: PROJECTION_NORMALIZATION_VERSION is bumped and the golden, explorer and benchmark fixtures are regenerated in one reviewed change
